t_bar.formula: T(N,W) = t_bar(N) + s*W (globaltimer spin, arm a); t_bar_us = coeffs.t_bar_us[N]

t_window_exposed.formula: extra T vs empty phase = a + b*nld (nld x 32 KB loads issued in the barrier window, N=148, W=0, drained before the next arrive)

lat_bar.formula: lat (median exit - max arrive) = a + b*nld

range.W: idle spin 3us / 48 tcgen05 MMAs per phase

t_stream.formula: busy work t(S,N,R) = t0(R) + S / min(r_sm(R), BW_agg(R)/N); S in bytes, rates in GB/s (1e9 B/s); t = median over active CTAs of (barrier-p arrive - barrier-(p-1) exit), mean over phases 2..nph; spread placement; no prefetch; fit on S>=64 KB, N in {8..148}

range.R_note: R=8 does not fit in smem (227 KB)

t_stream_last.formula: same model, t = slowest active CTA's work (max over CTAs), spread placement

t_stream_firstN.formula: same as t_stream (busy), first-N blockIdx placement

gate_aggregate.formula: measured aggregate GB/s = 148*S/last (slowest CTA), N=148 spread, R=4, S=7424 KB; why (11678) 5714 (static) .. 6727 (static_il_al) GB/s

t_B_a1_idle.formula: t_B = lat_us + bytes / thr_B_per_us (bytes: T*kb*4 fp32 bytes)

t_B_a1_loaded.formula: t_B = lat_us + bytes / thr_B_per_us (bytes: T*kb*4 fp32 bytes)

t_B_b_idle.formula: t_B = lat_us + bytes / thr_B_per_us (bytes: T*kb*2 [TT*kb*2 incl. pad rows])

t_B_b_loaded.formula: t_B = lat_us + bytes / thr_B_per_us (bytes: T*kb*2 [TT*kb*2 incl. pad rows])

t_B_c_idle.formula: t_B = lat_us + bytes / thr_B_per_us (bytes: T*kb*4 fp32 bytes)

t_B_c_loaded.formula: t_B = lat_us + bytes / thr_B_per_us (bytes: T*kb*4 fp32 bytes)

t_B3_a1_idle.formula: t_B = lat_us + per_unit_us*(kb/128 k-steps for a1, TMA boxes else) + us_per_KB*KB (bytes_smem = TT*kb*2; c: T*kb*4)

hidden.formula: busy(S,P,win) = busy(S,0,win) - hidden; hidden = slope * P*32KB / min(r_sm(R), BW_agg(R)/N) [us]  (+ intercept); busy(S,0) ~ B1 t_stream(S,N,R) (+0..+1.7 us at N=48, see NOTES). exposed = busy - floor, floor = 0.15 us (stream-free phase, same barriers). win = exit - arrive of the spin barrier (us) = 1.0 for spread < 0.5, ~0.85 + 0.88*spread above; the all-CTA spin W does not change win or busy (max 0.08 us)
hidden.units: us; r_sm, BW_agg from b1_stream/params.json (per R)

gate_floors_busy_us.formula: busy work of mk MK_NULL b8 phases reproduced with P = R, as function of window

t_chain.formula: t_tile = a + SPT * t_step; cycles (clock64) and us (globaltimer); one entry per (N, nacc, nact, commit_tile, dep); t_step/8 = per-MMA cycles

m1_loop.formula: t = a + b*n_iter + c*n_tok_max + d*T (KS=1); n_iter = max over epilogue groups of loop iterations (mode 4: chunks; others: ceil(chunks/2)), n_tok_max = max over groups of valid tokens they process

m1_vis.formula: t = a + b*n_iter + c*n_tok_max + d*T (KS=1); n_iter = max over epilogue groups of loop iterations (mode 4: chunks; others: ceil(chunks/2)), n_tok_max = max over groups of valid tokens they process

m2_dvis_KS.formula: vis(KS) - vis(1) = a*(KS-1) + b*(KS-1)*T (nw 4/8/12, all TT)

a_idle.formula: t_fin = a_us*x0 + b_us_per_32tok_iter*x1 + extra_job_us_per_iter*x2 + extra_job_us*x3; a/b: x = [1, n_it, (m-1)*n_it, (m-1)], n_it = ceil(min(T,128)/32), m = jobs per finalizing CTA (a: ceil(NJOB/nidle), b: ceil(T/128)); c: x = [1, min(T,128)]; NJOB = (H/128)*ceil(T/128)

b_lastprod.formula: t_fin = a_us*x0 + b_us_per_32tok_iter*x1 + extra_job_us_per_iter*x2 + extra_job_us*x3; a/b: x = [1, n_it, (m-1)*n_it, (m-1)], n_it = ceil(min(T,128)/32), m = jobs per finalizing CTA (a: ceil(NJOB/nidle), b: ceil(T/128)); c: x = [1, min(T,128)]; NJOB = (H/128)*ceil(T/128)

c_all.formula: t_fin = a_us*x0 + b_us_per_token(T<=128)*x1; a/b: x = [1, n_it, (m-1)*n_it, (m-1)], n_it = ceil(min(T,128)/32), m = jobs per finalizing CTA (a: ceil(NJOB/nidle), b: ceil(T/128)); c: x = [1, min(T,128)]; NJOB = (H/128)*ceil(T/128)

t_empty_floor.formula: t_fin of the empty finalizer arm (poll/ticket-observe + fence), T <= 128, mean over H, KS

redadd_T.formula: T = t0 + a*max_steps + c_red*red_tiles + c_pl*plain_tiles; max_steps = tiles_max*steps_per_tile (common/tiles.py ts); red_tiles = tiles_max*min(T,TT)/128 if KS>1 else 0; plain_tiles = same if KS==1 (128x128 fp32 tile per CTA = 64 KB); window prefetch on

ws_T.formula: T = t0 + a*max_steps + c_pl*partial_tiles + r*read_MB, read_MB = KS*T*N*4/1e6; two barriers per phase; window prefetch at the end barrier
